props.title: IGT / Lev convergence: sources multiply, authority does not.
props.subtitle: A paused synthesis of IGT, QIT, world-engine zips, Josh wiki, RepoPrompt prior art, and current Leviathan source state.

props.content: The convergence is operational admission architecture, not theory equivalence. IGT, QIT, world-engine simulations, shuttle packets, and wiki material all become source candidates. Deterministic Lev code owns Measurement, discharge, EvalDecision, routing, receipts, and world mutation.

props.label: Current ruling
props.title: What converges, and what stays open.
Converges
props.content: Source/proposal/evidence -> deterministic source contract -> Measurement -> gate-policy discharge -> EvalDecision/routing -> reconciler/world-model mutation only after proof. This pattern repeats across prior world-entry work, CR packets, sim-witness, world-engine output, and current Lev.

props.title: Still open
props.content: Axis0/Xi theory closure, shared CR/Lev lexicon convergence, product packet ingestion, evaluator-pack runtime callers, and the U2 world-model/reconciler composition root are not complete.

props.label: Architecture
props.title: The converged spine is one ingress pipe with one authority plane.

props.content:
flowchart LR
  A[Source packet, wiki, sim, prior art] --> B[Source-family normalizer]
  B --> C[Candidate or provider evidence]
  C --> D[lev.measurement.v1]
  D --> E[core/eval discharge]
  E --> F[EvalDecision and routing]
  F --> G[Reconciler observation or proposal]
  G --> H[G1 admissibility]
  H --> I[G2 materiality]
  I --> J[G3 surprise]
  J --> K[Render, seal receipt, emit]
  C -. forbidden .-> X[Direct truth, proof, or graph mutation]

The report rejects direct world-model ingestion. World-model runtime should receive admitted observations through routing, not raw theory packets. Graph output remains a projection/query plane, not the source of truth.

props.label: Recommendation
props.title: Use plugin/intake source loading; reject direct world-model ingestion.
Recommended landing pattern
props.content: Manifest-first packet/source loader -> source-family normalizer -> candidate/evidence record -> core/eval Measurement/discharge -> routing policy -> reconciler observation/proposal -> U2-backed world-model G3 seam.

props.title: Rejected landing patterns
props.content: Do not make core/eval own every source family forever. Do not feed raw packets into world-model runtime. Do not treat FlowMind/YAML declarations as runtime proof before deterministic callers exist.

props.title: 4. Land U2 composition root

props.title: 5. Route admitted observations into reconciler
props.content: Only after EvalDecision/routing should source candidates become reconciler observations or proposals. Graph remains projection.
